title: Free Printable Pumpkin Carving Stencils
summary: Download and print out these FREE Once Upon a Farm pumpkin carving stencils here.
body_markdown:
Get ready for festive fall fun, with some Once Upon a Farm flair! Download and print out your favorite stencil(s) from the 6 options below, grab a pumpkin, and get to carving. And don't forget to save the[pumpkin seeds](https://onceuponafarmorganics.com/blogs/upon-a-blog/5-perks-of-pumpkin-seeds) for a yummy snack! 🎃


## 1. Tractor Pumpkin Stencil


### Printing Instructions:


1. [Click this link to download PDF file](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1889/4791/files/PumpkinCarvingStencils_Tractor.pdf?v=1759850228)
2. Print the file as a black-and-white page
